items.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 starts in 4 days — lock in your pass savings of up to $100 before prices rise
items.summary: Four days until TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 starts, when 10,000 founders, investors, and tech leaders gather in San Francisco's Moscone West on October 13-15. Save up to $100 on your price. Plus, save 50% on a second pass of the same type.
items.creator: TechCrunch Events
